Welcome to Danfield

A school where every child is nurtured to be great

Danfield International School is a place where learning is joyful, discipline is valued and every child's intellectual, social, physical, spiritual and moral development is cared for.

  • Safe, respectful and welcoming learning atmosphere

Learn More About Us
About Us

Our Purpose, Vision & Values

Everything we do at Danfield is guided by a clear mission, an inspiring vision and values that shape the character of every child.

To provide world-class basic and early childhood education in a safe, respectable, and welcoming atmosphere where each child's intellectual, social, physical, spiritual and moral development needs are met in an academic-rich environment that builds a solid foundation for life-long learning.

To be a leading institution providing world-class basic education and early childhood development-training in Ghana.

What We Stand For

Academics

An Academic-Rich Environment

From first steps in the classroom to confident, curious learners, our programmes build a strong foundation for life-long learning.

Early Years

Early Childhood

Play-based, nurturing learning that builds language, numeracy, social skills and a love for school.

Basic School

Primary School

A rich curriculum in literacy, mathematics, science, ICT, creative arts and character formation.

Upper Basic

Junior High School

Rigorous academics, practical STEM projects and leadership training that prepare students for the next level.

Learning Beyond the Textbook

Where curiosity meets technology

Our learners explore electronics, coding and problem-solving through hands-on projects in our STEM lab, and enjoy a well-stocked library that grows readers.

Students build real circuits, program microcontrollers and experiment with sensors, turning classroom science into exciting discovery.
Bright reading spaces and a growing collection of books encourage every child to read widely and think deeply.
Spiritual and moral growth sits alongside academics, so our children grow in integrity as well as intellect.
Cultural celebrations, music and arts help learners express themselves and take pride in their heritage.
Admissions

Join the Danfield Family

Enrolling your child is simple. Follow these four easy steps and our team will guide you every step of the way.

Enquire

Call, email or fill the enquiry form to tell us about your child.

Visit

Tour our campus and meet our friendly teachers and staff.

Apply

Submit the application form and required documents.

Enrol

Receive your admission letter and welcome your child to Danfield!

What You'll Need

Please have these ready when you visit or apply:

  • Completed application form
  • Copy of child's birth certificate
  • Recent passport-size photographs
  • Previous school report (where applicable)
  • Parent / guardian identification

Requirements and fees may be updated by the school. Please contact us to confirm the current details.

Admission Enquiry

Send us your details and we'll get back to you shortly.

All fields are required.
